resolution.rationale: Different measures, not two values of one KPI. F0044 (34%) is the share of 2025 LOST DEALS where sales reported price; F0054's 58% is the share of 2025 CHURNED customers who never fully implemented the product (its price figure is 14%). Both are used, each for its own measure: 34% as the caveat on new-business price pressure, 58%/17%/14% for churn reasons.
